verdict.rationale: Docs confirm Klaviyo accepts arbitrary custom event data without pre-configured schema (klaviyo-docs-8, klaviyo-docs-24) and that flows can be set up based on Klaviyo events (klaviyo-docs-17), which is the mechanism for triggering per-person automations from custom events. However, the pack never explicitly documents the Events/Track API endpoint or confirms that a flow triggers specifically and only for the profile that fired the event. Missing for 10: explicit Track/Events API endpoint reference, confirmation of profile-specific (not broadcast) flow triggering, and any independent/hands-on validation.
